protocol.name: ferese_window_capture_v1
protocol.description: Captures only a managed toplevel's surface tree, independently of its workspace, occlusion, animations and output transform. The compositor advertises this interface only to its native portal executable. Capture requires session opt-in and fails while locked. Window IDs are compositor lifetime IDs and never resolve to replacement windows.

request.name: capture_window
request.description: The two unsigned words encode a 64-bit window ID (high word first). A version 1 wlr screencopy frame announces a bounded SHM ARGB8888 snapshot. It fails if the target has closed, capture is unavailable, or the outstanding snapshot budget is exhausted. Resize after the buffer announcement does not change this frame's dimensions. Overlay cursor is zero for hidden and one for embedded.

event.name: busy
event.description: Sent before this frame's failed event if the bounded snapshot pool is occupied. Retry a later frame; this does not revoke the window source.

event.name: geometry

description.summary: logical dimensions of the announced snapshot

event.description: Sent before the frame's buffer event. These dimensions describe this captured frame, even if the window resizes before it is copied.

request.name: create_source

description.summary: create a persistent window capture source

request.description: Creates a source for ext-image-copy-capture-v1. Unlike a snapshot, a session waits for content damage and negotiates reusable buffers. Invalid, closed or protected windows produce a stopped session.

request.name: refresh_source

description.summary: request an initial image after a consumer resumes

request.description: Invalidates the last delivered image for this source's sessions, so a resumed PipeWire consumer receives an initial image even when the source is unchanged. Outstanding buffers keep their ownership and GPU synchronization; this request never cancels a capture in flight. Subsequent frames continue to wait for source damage.

event.name: source_geometry

description.summary: logical dimensions of the capture source

event.description: The current logical window size, sent when the source is created. Subsequent pixel-size changes are announced by the capture session.
